_meta.name: godaddy-add-dns-record
_meta.description: Add one DNS record to a GoDaddy-hosted zone through the DNS Records page. Every field is read back before Save; after Save the record is confirmed in the type-filtered table. The authoritative-nameserver check (dig +norec with the aa flag) lives in scripts/godaddy-dns.mjs, which wraps this recipe and is the one-call entry point.
_meta.verificationNotes: Version 1.1.0 (2026-09-15) adds the s00 feature guard and has not yet run live. Version 1.0.0 was verified live on mike-wolf.com, 2026-09-14, extension build 0.1.540, through scripts/godaddy-dns.mjs, adding the _yeshie-test TXT record: all 30 steps ok, then ns57 and ns58.domaincontrol.com both answered with the record and the aa flag. Earlier versions lost the Filters click twice (straight after Save, and during a slow load in a hidden tab); s19a-s19d now reload the page and wait for the table to settle and for Filters to be enabled. Run log: sites/dcc.godaddy.com/README.md.
_meta.requires: A runtime that lists the feature select (src/runtime-features.ts); s00 checks it, and every build since 2026-09-13 stops there unless it lists the feature. Without the check, an older build would return 'unsupported' for select and run on, and s08 would then stop the chain before anything is saved. scripts/godaddy-dns.mjs also refuses a relay build below 0.1.540.
_meta.authorship: Mike Wolf (direction); Claude Opus 5 (CCc), 2026-09-14 — built from the 2026-09-14 hand-driven session that added the sala* A records. Feature guard: Claude Opus 5 (CCc), 2026-09-15.
anomalies: Record Type (#dnsRecordIdDropdown) and TTL (#ttl) are native React <select>s. Option values are lowercase (a, aaaa, cname, mx, txt, srv, caa, ns, https, svcb, tlsa); labels are uppercase. The `type` param is the lowercase value.
Choosing a Type re-renders the whole New Records row, including the <select> itself. Anything located before the type change is stale; every later step re-queries by selector.
The Value input's id is regenerated per render (undefined-data-<uuid>). Use input[data-testid='dataDnsFieldInput'].
Save (#bulk-dns-records-save-btn) stays disabled until Type, Name and Value are filled. A synthetic click on a disabled button does nothing, so s17 waits for it to enable.
Cancel with unsaved changes opens a 'You have unsaved changes' dialog (Yes, Cancel / No, Go Back).
Filters (#dnsTableFilterBtn) is disabled while a New Records row is open. It filters by record type only (checkboxes named after the lowercase type); there is no name search.
The table pages at 10 rows, so a new record is often not on page 1. Filtering by type is how s20-s25 find it.

Tab selection: autoDiscoverRunTab prefers a tab on base_url's host but falls back to the ACTIVE tab when none exists. s01 refuses to run anywhere but dcc.godaddy.com, so the fallback can never navigate an unrelated tab away.

params.type: REQUIRED — GoDaddy's lowercase option value: a, aaaa, cname, mx, txt, srv, caa, ns, https, svcb, tlsa
params.name: REQUIRED — the host label relative to the domain; @ for the apex
params.value: REQUIRED — record data (an IPv4 address for A, the target host for CNAME, the text for TXT)
